answer: Sybil resistance employs attestations to unique, non-fungible physical hardware components. Each AI agent, to join the economy, must cryptographically prove control over a distinct hardware ID, mapped onto a global "atlas" of registered devices. This prevents easy identity proliferation, as an attacker faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring and maintaining discrete physical units. Forging countless agents before dawn becomes economically infeasible, as unique willow tree saplings must be planted for each fake identity, costing real-world resources.
